en: Better ring on the security.

en: But anyway, so security breaches are inevitable.
zh: 但无论如何，安全漏洞是不可避免的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the premise was...
zh: 而前提是……

en: That let's respond to every breach that matters.
zh: 让我们对每一个重要的漏洞做出响应。

en: So we have first mover intelligence on how to prevent it happening again.

en: You know, it was like, we look for malware, we have signatures for it.

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we miss...
zh: 而如果我们漏掉了……

en: David George has to find the malware and submit it to us so we get better.

zh: 而那是个糟糕的模型。

en: My mother's not finding malware on her laptop.

speaker: Unknown
en: It's just gonna eat her laptop alive.
zh: 这会把她笔记本电脑活活吃掉。

en: So that model was bad.
zh: 所以那个模型很糟糕。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we decided a better model because I responded to breaches.
zh: 所以我们决定了一个更好的模型，因为我应对过数据泄露事件。

en: And the reason I was responding to them is AV was easily evaded.

zh: 所以我们就想，好吧，我们来学习所有的，你知道，我们做 AV 的第二层，因为它太烂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's what George now owns, you know?
zh: 这就是 George 现在负责的东西，你知道吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: So that's second layer AV.

speaker: Unknown
en: You still have to have AV though.
zh: 但你还是得有 AV。

en: I beat it up, but the reality is, is you still need it or something that replaces it.
zh: 我把它骂了个遍，但现实是，你仍然需要它，或者某种取代它的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the second layer of defense was required.
zh: 所以第二道防线是必需的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So AV was imaginal line to here.
zh: 所以 AV 就是想象线到这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then you extend the imaginal line with something that can learn and think.
zh: 然后你要用某种能够学习、能够思考的东西来延伸这条想象线。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so we wanted to do that.
zh: 所以我们就想做这件事。

en: Somehow get there, they'd beat you.

en: But we got that model now and it's just not good enough.
zh: 但我们现在有那个模型了，只是它还不够好。

en: Yeah.

en: And when I started Mandian, it was, Hey, this is what we do for a living.
zh: 而我创办 Mandian 的时候，就是，嘿，这是我们赖以谋生的事情。

en: Let's make enough money to do it for a living.
zh: 我们赚足够的钱来以此为生。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's it.
zh: 就这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, so we hired the best people and we had a philosophy of, we're going to pay you more than our competition, but you're going to work harder.
zh: 我的意思是，所以我们雇了最优秀的人，我们有这样一个理念：我们付给你的钱会比竞争对手多，但你要更努力地工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we always felt like we had less people working harder, but better people.
zh: 所以我们一直觉得我们人更少、干得更拼命，但人更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I think we were known for having great talent and that talent has prevailed.
zh: 是啊，我觉得我们以拥有杰出人才而闻名，而那些人才延续了下来。

en: There was a time about a year ago, somebody sent me a text and they said, congratulations, 43% of the RSA main stage keynotes are Mandian alumni.

speaker: Unknown
en: Come on.

en: And that's the text I got.

en: I never verified it, but the guy's pretty accurate.
zh: 我从没核实过，但那家伙挺准的。

en: I'll take that stat if that's true, you know, and I think it probably was.

en: You know, we've got a lot of reach over time with a lot of talent.

en: You know, he has spawned a lot of, from FoundSone you've spawned a lot of successful companies and people.

speaker: Unknown
en: So same thing with Mandiant, but the differences are this, A, gotta be funded, B,

en: Oh, your growth rate, get the market now.

en: Like I look at Arminen's opportunity.

speaker: Unknown
en: I feel like we have an 80 mile an hour tailwind, but we don't have a sales force.
zh: 我觉得我们有一股时速 80 英里的顺风，但我们没有销售团队。

en: We don't have a go to market.

speaker: Unknown
en: We're not international.
zh: 我们还不是国际化的。

en: All that just has to happen.

en: We're going to try to beat that.

en: And that's what you have to do, especially when you're needed, necessary, and you have to exist.

en: You can't win

en: It's how do we do that and feel comfortable doing it?
zh: 就是我们如何做到这一点，并且做起来心安理得？

speaker: Unknown
en: And here's complications, so let's do it.

en: A, you got to grow fast.

en: Yeah, exactly.

en: So I'm trying to figure out, wait a minute, we're different every two weeks.
zh: 所以我正在琢磨，等等，我们每两周就变一次。

speaker: Unknown
en: What is the modality now of having a sales core that is right up to date?
zh: 现在要让销售团队完全跟上最新状态的模式是什么？

en: And here's the challenge that I thought, every CEO I've talked to is like, how does AI change our business?
zh: 我想到的挑战是这样的，我交谈过的每个 CEO 都在问，AI 如何改变我们的业务？

en: You still need the same damn go-to-market structure for now.
zh: 目前你仍然需要同样该死的 go-to-market 结构。

en: And in fact, it's even more in bold because the tech's changing so fast, you can't put that onus on the customer to figure out how did you change, where is it at?
zh: 而且事实上，它甚至更加重要了，因为技术变化太快，你不能把弄清楚“你们改了什么、现在到哪了”这个担子甩给客户。

en: So we have got to create a process, institutionalize.
zh: 所以我们必须创建一个流程，制度化。

en: Where sales is trained every week.

en: Where are we at?

en: How are we doing?

en: And these are processes that will get you to win, you know.
zh: 而这些流程会让你赢，你知道的。

en: Yeah, carry with the credibility on the security side, right?
zh: 是啊，带着安全方面的信誉，对吧？

zh: 有人问，那你怎么知道自己是最强的？

en: And I'm like, when you are the best, you know it.
zh: 我就说，当你是最强的时候，你自己知道。

en: You know, you have to be the best.

en: If you have to ask the question, you're probably not.

en: Yes.

en: Right?
